sanskrit: āviśya tattatpratyayabhūmiṣu || sivsv_3.19:3 ||* tattacchabdānuvedhena mohanāt paśumātaraḥ || sivsv_3.19:4 ||* āvṛṇvānā nijaṃ rūpaṃ cidānandaghanātmakam || sivsv_3.19:5 ||* atimānaṃ vivṛṇvānāḥ śarīrādau jaḍe 'pi ca || sivsv_3.19:6 ||* paśuvatsādhakam api pramattaṃ mohayanty amūḥ || sivsv_3.19:7 ||* tasmād bhāvyaṃ sadānena sāvadhānena yoginā || sivsv_3.19:8 ||* uktaṃ sāmānyato jñānādhiṣṭhānaṃ mātṛkety ataḥ || sivsv_3.19:9 ||* idaṃ tu prāptatattvo 'pi pramādyan sādhakaḥ punaḥ || sivsv_3.19:10 ||* paśvadhiṣṭhānabhūtābhir mohyate mātṛbhis tv iti || sivsv_3.19:11 ||* yata evam ataḥ śuddhavidyā prāptāpi yuktibhiḥ || sivsv_3.19:12 ||* bahvībhiḥ sā punar mauḍhyādy athāsya na vinaśyati || sivsv_3.19:13 ||
